meta.title: A Surprise for Grandma
meta.textType: story: the theme of a story

paragraphs: On Saturday, Lily and Tom went to Green Hill with Mom, Dad, and Pip. Lily wanted to make a surprise for Grandma. Grandma cooked in the kitchen, and the house smelled good. Tom played volleyball with Dad on the grass. Lily took a laptop to the garden and sat under a tree. She put twenty photos of the garden in one slideshow. It took two hours, and she was very proud.

Then Lily pressed a wrong key, and the slideshow disappeared. "Oh no! I have just lost my file," she said. She looked for it, but she could not find it anywhere on the laptop. Lily put her head on the table and did not speak. Tom stopped his game of volleyball and came to her. Pip jumped after the ball and ran away with it.

"What happened?" asked Tom. "The slideshow is gone," said Lily. "I worked for two hours, and I do not want to start again." Tom sat next to her and looked at the screen. "You should try again," he said. "This time, you can save the file in one folder." "I will help you." Lily took a deep breath, and she began again. Pip came back with the ball and lay down next to her feet.

This time, Lily worked faster, and Tom saved the file every five minutes. She chose the best photos, and she wrote a short title. The new slideshow was better than the first one. Grandma called everyone to the table, and Lily was a little nervous. After dinner, Lily put the laptop on the table. "I have a surprise for you, Grandma," she said.

Grandma looked at the photos of the garden and the old tree. "This is wonderful," she said. "Thank you, Lily." Grandpa smiled and said, "My wife loves her garden." "And this dinner was delicious," said Dad. Lily looked at Tom and smiled. "I almost stopped," she said, "but I tried again."
text.summary: Lily makes a photo slideshow as a surprise for Grandma in Green Hill. She loses the file, but Tom helps her, and she tries again, so the theme is to try again.
